annotation.title_clean: OSH and the Future of Work: benefits and risks of artificial intelligence tools in workplaces
annotation.title_en: OSH and the Future of Work: benefits and risks of artificial intelligence tools in workplaces
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA publication landing page for a 2019 18-page discussion paper on the occupational safety and health implications of AI and big data at work. Examples include people analytics, AI-augmented robotics, chatbots and wearables. The paper looks at what goes wrong when these tools are implemented poorly and what conditions are needed to implement them well.
key_provisions_or_claims: Digital developments such as AI and big data will significantly change work and affect workers' wellbeing, safety and health
AI is used in workplaces for HR people analytics and recruitment, AI-augmented robotics, chatbots and wearables on assembly lines
Poor implementation of AI tools carries OSH risks; the paper outlines conditions for good implementation
